name: Summer Days in the Park
description_short: City run summer program for Clifton children ages 5 to 13, 9 to 3:30 weekdays, at School 3 (365 Washington Ave) and School 13 (782 Van Houten Ave). Weekly themes with games, crafts, special events and optional paid trips; children bring lunch and proof of Clifton residency is required at registration.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 parent information guide: Monday to Friday July 6 to August 14, 9 to 3:30, ages 5 through 13 as of October 1, 2025, in two three week sessions (July 6 to 24, July 27 to August 14) at School 3, 365 Washington Avenue, and School 13, 782 Van Houten Avenue. No before care or aftercare. Bag lunch from home. No transportation to and from the program (trips are bused). Scholarships for Clifton residents. Proof of residency required at registration. Program fee is not stated in the guide.
